propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) lack multi-page test coverage, with existing tests exercising only single-page payloads marked isLast: True
The cursor contract (termination on isLast OR null/absent nextPageToken) has no test asserting cursor advance, second-page fetch, or that repeated tokens do not spin forever

A repeated cursor token causes unbounded re-requests on the same offset (byte-identical request/response), making readers spin forever until transport errors, masked by fail-open exception handling as silently partial maps

Three dedicated regression nets (set recovery across 3 pages, cursor advance assertion, independent stop-condition isolation) plus AST guard prevent unpaginated whole-project search POSTs from being added silently on Cloud
